sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 15:4

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 15:4:1
items.html: Over many times she is corrected and grows little by little. And they are, in general, seven times, which were explained in Part 9, page 832, answer 40. Study it there well.
